fitted_on.dataset: TrueFake (Dell'Anna et al., IJCNN 2025, arXiv 2504.20658), Facebook-shared subset
fitted_on.detector: Community Forensics ViT-S/16 384 (classifier rung), score as the rung reports it (6 dp)
fitted_on.split: dev (35% of groups by sha256(SEED:group), PREREG section 2); held-out rows not read

gate_note: The 29 Oct classifier gate (classifier_gate.json) stays FAIL and is not retuned. These thresholds only route images in the desk queue; they never raise a ladder concern.
rule: Rule BAND, arena/PREREG.md section 5 (DAT-1366 J3): auto_decided when f = 1 or d >= t_hi (t_hi by rule OP, at most floor(0.01 x dev reals) dev reals flagged, ties to the highest); likely_fine when f = 0 and d < t_lo (t_lo the largest dev score with at most floor(0.01 x dev AI) dev AI images below it); everything else to a person.
